**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause.** Deploy `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, shipped 02:12–02:14 UTC) flipped the config flag `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. That made every request grab its own database connection instead of sharing from the pool. The pool only holds 20 connections, so it filled up fast. Every 503 since logs `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, and the queue of waiting requests has climbed the whole time, from 13 waiting at the start to 74 by the end of the log.

**Impact window.** First 503 at 02:14:18 UTC, 2026-03-14. Still failing at the last line in the log, 03:59:27 UTC. So over an hour and 45 minutes with no recovery. Only the gateway was hit. The worker log stayed clean through the same window, so background jobs kept running fine.

**Rollback.** Revert `dep-4471`. That's the only deploy that touched the gateway around the incident start, and its own summary says "connection-per-request for pool isolation," which lines up exactly with the setting that broke.
